the acceleration of cosmic rays by supernova remnants, the propagation of cosmic rays through the ISM, and the role cosmic rays play in determining the physical and chemical properties of the ISM.

the ionization rates toward the sight lines studied here are higher than in average diffuse molecular cloud regions, but the ionization rates are lower than those inferred toward diffuse atomic sight lines, suggesting that the cosmic-ray ionized fraction of the ISM increases with increasing density.
